themes.title: Everyday Keepsakes
themes.subtitle: Small traces of time in familiar objects.

themes.title: By the Window
themes.subtitle: See a familiar corner in a new light.

themes.title: Color Walk
themes.subtitle: Follow a color through the everyday.

themes.title: Shadow Map
themes.subtitle: Notice the shapes light leaves behind.

tasks.title: Three Views of a Keepsake
tasks.summary: Tell the story of a familiar object in three frames.
hints: Stay in one spot and include the full outline of the object.
Without moving your camera position, turn the object to show a well-used side.
Zoom in on a small mark, then arrange your photos into a sequence.

tasks.title: Time Between the Pages
tasks.summary: From one spot, record the traces of use on a book.
hints: Place the book in soft light. Photograph its cover and corners, then add a memory about it.

tasks.title: An Everyday Cup
tasks.summary: Keep your camera position fixed and compare two sides of a cup.
hints: Include the body and handle so the full shape is visible.
Turn only the cup or change your zoom to highlight wear along the rim.

tasks.title: A Map of Wear
tasks.summary: Use three close-up views to tell an object's history.
hints: Fill the image with a worn surface without showing the whole object.
Find a scratch or chipped paint and use side light to reveal its depth.
Photograph a different material to complete your quiet three-frame story.

tasks.title: Dog-eared Memories
tasks.summary: Make a small sign of reading the subject of your photo.
hints: Frame a crease, page edge or part of the spine. Add a short thought about reading.

tasks.title: Rim and Glaze
tasks.summary: Compare two textures on the same cup.
hints: Let the rim curve through the frame without showing the entire cup.
Capture a crack or a glossy patch and compare its texture with the first image.

tasks.title: A Keepsake in One Color
tasks.summary: Follow one main color across an object and its details.
hints: Choose wood brown, white or another main color. Remove distracting objects.
Photograph a place where use has made that color lighter or darker.
Find one more detail in the same color to connect all three photos.

tasks.title: A Cover in Color
tasks.summary: Use a book cover to capture a color you are drawn to today.
hints: Let the cover's main color fill most of the image. Write what it brings to mind.

tasks.title: A Cup of Light and Dark
tasks.summary: Find different shades of one color on a cup.
hints: Choose the cup's main color and photograph its lit surface.
Photograph a shaded area of the same color and compare the two tones.

tasks.title: Room for a Keepsake
tasks.summary: Give an old object space in a three-photo memory.
hints: Set the object to one side and keep the other side simple.
Photograph a sign of use, leaving at least a third of the frame clear.
Move the empty space to another side so the last photo feels like a pause.

tasks.title: Where Light Rests
tasks.summary: From one spot, observe how window light divides a room.
hints: Include the frame and part of the room to show where the light comes from.
Stay in place and turn your camera toward a lit table or wall.
Capture shade within the same view to build a sequence from light to dark.

tasks.title: Growing Toward Light
tasks.summary: Stay beside a window and notice how a plant reaches for light.
hints: Make the direction of the leaves clear. Add a line about their relationship with the light.

tasks.title: A Quiet Beam
tasks.summary: From a fixed position, compare a patch of light with its edge.
hints: Photograph a bright area in the room and keep your camera position fixed.
Reframe from the same spot so the boundary between light and shade becomes the subject.

tasks.title: Three Windowsill Details
tasks.summary: Collect small changes in light without showing the whole room.
hints: Photograph a short section of the window frame with its bright and dark sides.
Capture a fine mark or a drop of water on the sill.
Find a reflection in the glass to give each close-up a different texture.

tasks.title: Light on a Leaf Tip
tasks.summary: Look at how one leaf catches light, without showing the whole plant.
hints: Fill the image with the tip or edge of a leaf. Describe the change in light you notice.

tasks.title: An Edge of Light
tasks.summary: Compare the center of a bright patch with its edge in two close-ups.
hints: Choose a small lit area on a wall or table and keep its detail visible.
Photograph where it fades into shade. Notice whether the edge is soft or sharp.

tasks.title: Warm White by the Window
tasks.summary: Choose one color near a window and record its changing tones.
hints: Choose one color on a frame, curtain or wall.
Photograph its brightest area without losing all detail in the highlights.
Find a shaded area of the same color to complete a sequence of tones.

tasks.title: A Line of Green
tasks.summary: Make a plant's green the only strong color in the frame.
hints: Use leaves to hide a busy background. Add a short line describing this shade of green.

tasks.title: One Color, Two Tones
tasks.summary: Compare lit and shaded areas of a wall in the same color.
hints: Let one color dominate the frame and capture its sunlit state.
Record a shaded area of the same color, keeping the two compositions similar.

tasks.title: Space for Light
tasks.summary: Make three window-light photos with simple, open space in each.
hints: Let the window frame occupy one edge beside a plain wall.
Surround a small patch of light with a large, simple background.
Capture a soft shadow with empty space in the same direction as before.

tasks.title: Today's Favorite Color
tasks.summary: Stay in a safe spot and collect one color from the view around you.
hints: Pick a visible color and photograph its most noticeable appearance.
Stay in place and turn the camera to find another detail in that color.
Capture a lighter or darker shade to complete a color sequence.

tasks.title: Color Around the Corner
tasks.summary: Stay in a pedestrian area and record the color of a doorway.
hints: Photograph the door or window with the surrounding wall. Describe how the colors feel together.

tasks.title: Two Bright Spots
tasks.summary: From one safe position, compare two colors in the street.
hints: Choose a bright detail, keeping clear of traffic and passersby.
Turn your camera without moving to find a second color that relates to it.

tasks.title: Color Up Close
tasks.summary: Photograph fragments of colorful objects until their purpose disappears.
hints: Fill the image with a surface in one color.
Capture a detail where that color meets another material.
Find wear or a change in tone and arrange the three photos into a sequence.

tasks.title: Beside the Handle
tasks.summary: Capture one colorful part of a door or window.
hints: Choose paint beside a handle or a corner of a frame. Add a short description of its color.

tasks.title: Street Color Fragments
tasks.summary: Compare two small patches of color in close-up.
hints: From a safe pedestrian area, photograph a sign edge or a patch of painted ground.
Find another detail that connects to the first through its shape or color.

tasks.title: A Color's Journey
tasks.summary: Follow a safe walking route and find one color in three settings.
hints: Photograph your chosen color to establish the theme of the series.
Find a different object in the same color, avoiding other strong colors.
Capture a third setting and order the photos by distance or tone.

tasks.title: The Color of a Door
tasks.summary: Make one color on a door or window the focus of the image.
hints: Frame out competing colors and add a line about what this doorway brings to mind.

tasks.title: The Same Color Twice
tasks.summary: Find the same main color in two places along a walking route.
hints: Photograph a clear patch of color and remember its shade and shape.
Find the same color in another safe location. Compare what is similar and what changes.

tasks.title: Small Color, Big Space
tasks.summary: Make a small patch of color stand out against a simple background.
hints: Place the colorful subject in a corner with plenty of simple space around it.
Try another subject position while keeping the empty space clear.
End with an even smaller patch of color so the sequence grows quieter.

tasks.title: The Other Side of a Shadow
tasks.summary: Stay in one spot and study a shadow's shape, edge and overlaps.
hints: From a safe position, capture the shadow's full outline.
Keep your position and adjust the zoom to record a soft or sharp edge.
Capture where two shadows meet, giving each photo a different focus.

tasks.title: Wind on the Wall
tasks.summary: Stand beside a tree's shade and capture a moment in its movement.
hints: Wait for the leaves to move gently, photograph a shape you like and add a thought about it.

tasks.title: The Path of Light
tasks.summary: From the same spot, compare sunlight with the line where it ends.
hints: First capture a complete area of light and shade.
Stay in place and turn the camera to emphasize the boundary's direction or bend.

tasks.title: Inside a Shadow
tasks.summary: Collect three fragments without showing a shadow's full outline.
hints: Frame a small part of a shadow so its source is hard to guess.
Photograph where the shadow meets the texture of the ground.
Find a crossing of dark lines to complete an abstract three-frame story.

tasks.title: A Leaf's Shadow
tasks.summary: Discover the shapes in a small patch of tree shade on a wall.
hints: Fill the photo with a few leaf shadows. Write what they resemble or how they change.

tasks.title: Seams of Light
tasks.summary: Compare two kinds of boundary between light and shade.
hints: Capture a close-up with a clearly defined light-shadow boundary.
Photograph a softly fading edge to create a contrast with the first image.

tasks.title: Shadows on One Color
tasks.summary: Record three shadow shapes against surfaces of the same color.
hints: Find a wall or ground surface in one color and capture a shadow on it.
Find a shadow pointing in a different direction against the same background color.
Record a change in density and arrange the three photos into a rhythm.

tasks.title: Beyond the Green
tasks.summary: Let tree shade stand out on a wall with one consistent color.
hints: Keep other colors out of the background. Photograph the layers of shade and add a short caption.

tasks.title: A Wall in Two Moods
tasks.summary: Compare light and shade over the same background color.
hints: Fill the frame with one base color and preserve detail in the lit surface.
Photograph a shaded area of the same color and compare the brightness.

tasks.title: A Shadow in Open Space
tasks.summary: Give shadows plenty of room in three quiet compositions.
hints: Keep the shadow on one side and the rest of the frame simple.
Find another shadow with empty space on a different side.
End the series with the smallest shadow and the most empty space.

tasks.title: Everyday Circles
tasks.summary: Stay in one spot and find circles, repetition and a curved detail.
hints: Capture a whole circle along with some of its surroundings.
Stay in place and look for two or more similar circles.
Change your zoom to frame a single arc, moving the series toward abstraction.

tasks.title: Lines That Lead
tasks.summary: From one safe position, find lines stretching through the scene.
hints: Use a railing, door frame or floor seam to lead the eye. Write where it takes you.

tasks.title: Order Around a Corner
tasks.summary: Study a structure and its repetition from the same position.
hints: Keep the camera level and show the main structure of a frame, column or wall.
Stay in place and zoom to capture a repeated arrangement of windows or columns.

tasks.title: The Story of an Arc
tasks.summary: Make curved fragments the subject without revealing a full circle.
hints: Frame part of a circle's edge without showing the full shape.
Find another arc with a different size or direction.
Photograph where a curve meets a straight line to complete the third frame.

tasks.title: Where Lines Turn
tasks.summary: Follow a short line as it turns or meets another.
hints: Choose part of a wall seam, railing or ground marking. Add a line describing its direction.

tasks.title: Two Slices of a Building
tasks.summary: Compare two structural details without showing an entire building.
hints: From a safe spot, capture a small group of windows, bricks or railings.
Find one detail that breaks the pattern and compare it with the first image.

tasks.title: Circles in One Color
tasks.summary: Choose one main color and find three compositions with circles.
hints: Keep the circle and its background within one main color.
Find an arrangement of circles in that color and compare size and spacing.
End with an arc in the same color, keeping variety within the sequence.

tasks.title: A Drawing in One Color
tasks.summary: Remove competing colors so real lines resemble a drawing.
hints: Choose a surface with one dominant tone and clear lines. Describe the order you see.

tasks.title: A Building's Color
tasks.summary: Compare patterns on architectural surfaces of one color.
hints: Photograph regular rows of windows, bricks or columns in the same color.
Find a bend, gap or change in shadow within that color.

tasks.title: Circles and Space
tasks.summary: Explore a circle's position using three kinds of empty space.
hints: Place a whole circle to one side against a simple background.
Photograph the space between two circles, making the gap the focus.
Let an arc enter from the edge and leave the rest open.

tasks.title: A World Within Reach
tasks.summary: From one position, use three framings to get to know a material.
hints: Show the object clearly enough to explain what the material is used for.
Keep your position and zoom to find the direction of its surface pattern.
Turn the object or zoom again to capture its most distinctive detail.

tasks.title: Landscape of a Leaf
tasks.summary: Observe a leaf from one spot without picking it.
hints: Show the edge and veins, then add a line about something you noticed.

tasks.title: Soft Terrain
tasks.summary: Keep your camera fixed and compare a fold with a lit fabric surface.
hints: Let a clear fold run across the image.
Keep the camera in place and gently adjust the fabric to create a flatter lit surface.

tasks.title: Secrets of a Surface
tasks.summary: Use three close-ups to describe a material without revealing the object.
hints: Fill the image with texture so the object's purpose is hidden.
Find a seam, worn patch or natural spot.
Use side light to reveal bumps and hollows, giving each photo a different feel.

tasks.title: Where Veins Branch
tasks.summary: Observe the point where a leaf's vein divides.
hints: Leave the leaf in place, capture a few fine veins and add a thought about branching paths.

tasks.title: Between the Threads
tasks.summary: Compare the lines and folds of fabric in two close-ups.
hints: Fill the frame with woven threads or soft fibers.
Capture a small rise or fold to contrast with the flatter texture of the first image.

tasks.title: One Color, Three Textures
tasks.summary: Find three surface variations within one main color.
hints: Choose a surface in one color and first record its overall pattern.
Photograph lighter and darker areas created by its uneven surface.
Find a seam or worn patch in the same color to give the third image its own texture.

tasks.title: A Patch of Green
tasks.summary: Fill the image with green and notice the subtle layers of a leaf.
hints: Keep other colors outside the frame. Add a short line about the shade of green you see.

tasks.title: Fabric in Two Tones
tasks.summary: Compare light and shade on fabric in the same color.
hints: Choose a fabric with one main color and photograph its lit surface.
Find a fold or shaded area in the same fabric and compare the two tones.

tasks.title: Texture with Room to Breathe
tasks.summary: Give a small textured detail room in three simple compositions.
hints: Keep a textured surface to one side and leave a large, simple background.
Frame a second detail with empty space on another side.
End with a smaller fragment and more open space around it.
